item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-96f3f2c2bd3b5b11","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"In July 2023, Chinese authorities launched a campaign to remove administrative obstacles to a national unified market and fair competition, including barriers to market entry and exit, movement of goods and production factors, and business activity; responsible authorities were instructed to abolish or rectify targeted policies.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.7","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; announcement and planned implementation are documented, but outcome evidence is not provided.","ruler_attribution":"The policy was issued by Chinese authorities under the central government; the source does not document a personal decision by Xi Jinping.","limitations":["Official government account; no independent assessment of implementation or effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7062027a08322dab","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"The 2023 central-government final accounts reported 9.96 trillion yuan in general public-budget revenue, equal to 99.4% of budget, and 14.11 trillion yuan in expenditure, equal to 97.9% of the adjusted budget; the report also stated that fiscal departments would prioritize basic livelihoods and local-government debt management.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.6","5B.9","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Reports execution during 2023, though published in June 2024.","ruler_attribution":"Reported by the State Council finance minister to the National People's Congress; no personal Xi action is specified.","limitations":["Official final-account report; does not establish whether spending achieved intended welfare or economic outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-11a0bcea504e87bc","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"In September 2023, Xi Jinping directed that new industrialization be treated as a key task for Chinese modernization, combining manufacturing development with the digital economy and industrial informationization, while requiring policy and factor support and a work structure led by party organizations, implemented by government, and involving enterprises and society.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated September 2023; the document records directives and organizational arrangements but not completed outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"Direct personal attribution: Xi Jinping issued the instruction.","limitations":["The source is an official summary and does not provide budget amounts, milestones, or independent implementation evidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b27bd7e6b644dfc2","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On National Constitution Day in December 2023, Xi Jinping called for maintaining constitutional authority, advancing constitutional development, and strengthening constitutional implementation, interpretation, and supervision while improving the constitutional legal system and public legal education.","question_ids":["4B.4","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly dated December 2023; describes stated priorities rather than independently verified institutional practice.","ruler_attribution":"Direct personal attribution: Xi Jinping issued the instruction.","limitations":["The instruction simultaneously affirms the Communist Party's constitutional leadership and does not establish independent judicial or legislative constraint on the ruler."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9f2d0df2259cd084","start_unit":1,"end_unit":14,"fact_summary":"The National Healthcare Security Administration's 2023 information-disclosure report recorded 104 proactively disclosed items, 61 new information requests, 67 completed requests, 43 fully disclosed outcomes, 3 requests carried into the next year, and several refusals based on security, third-party rights, internal-affairs, or other statutory grounds; the agency acknowledged that policy interpretation needed improvement.","question_ids":["5B.7","6B.5","6B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Covers January–December 2023; published January 2024.","ruler_attribution":"Institutional report by the National Healthcare Security Administration; no personal Xi action is specified.","limitations":["Concerns one agency's disclosure practice and does not measure broader transparency or welfare outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-68d4940b317be14f","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"At a May 2023 State Council meeting, authorities ordered special rectification of local protection and market segmentation, and called for stronger property-rights protection, market access, fair competition, social-credit systems, and evaluation mechanisms; the meeting also adopted guidance for regular, digital, intelligent, and public supervision of healthcare-security funds.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.5","5B.7","6B.5","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within May 2023; records adopted directives, not verified results.","ruler_attribution":"The meeting was chaired by Premier Li Qiang; no personal Xi action is specified.","limitations":["Official account; implementation, enforcement consistency, and independent evaluation are not documented."]},{"source_id":"SRC-693ee7c8c8ee66b6","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"For 2023, Chinese disciplinary authorities reported investigating 107,547 violations of the Central Eight Regulations, criticizing or disciplining 153,662 people, and imposing party or administrative sanctions on 108,695; the report also identified substantial cases involving formalism, dereliction, improper benefits, food and gift violations, and misuse of allowances.","question_ids":["5B.5","7B.9","7B.10","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Annual figures cover 2023; source published January 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The enforcement program is associated with the central disciplinary authorities and the Central Eight Regulations; personal Xi direction is not documented in this source.","limitations":["The figures show enforcement activity and continuing violations, but not net prevalence, procedural fairness, or recovery of losses."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e227b7541079628f","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The ILO's September 2023 compendium describes national social-protection systems in 52 country cases and identifies legal frameworks, national ownership, social dialogue, and adaptation to informality, climate change, crises, and fiscal pressures as factors in developing inclusive and sustainable protection systems.","question_ids":[],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Published in 2023 but not specific to China or Xi Jinping's 2023 policies.","ruler_attribution":"No attribution to Xi Jinping or China.","limitations":["The supplied units provide no China-specific evidence and no fact materially answering the supplied lenses for Xi."]},{"source_id":"SRC-bfb5f6efffad2156","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"In July 2023, Xi Jinping instructed authorities to strengthen cybersecurity and informatization through party control of the internet, network-security safeguards, legal regulation, information-technology development, and coordinated organizational responsibility; the directive also emphasized positive online messaging and maintaining control over online ideology.","question_ids":["1B.9","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly dated July 2023; records formal directives and institutional responsibilities, not independently verified effects.","ruler_attribution":"Direct personal attribution: Xi Jinping issued the instruction.","limitations":["The source does not provide specific safeguards, oversight results, or evidence of protection for political expression; it explicitly combines cybersecurity with ideological control."]},{"source_id":"SRC-430a2d910c066904","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"During the first three quarters of 2023, Chinese disciplinary authorities reported 1.283 million disposed problem leads and 470,000 cases opened; they also reported 79,721 Central Eight Regulations violations in January–October, 80,096 party or administrative sanctions, 12,000 bribery cases opened in the first three quarters, and 46,000 village party-secretary or village-director cases opened from January through September.","question_ids":["5B.5","7B.9","7B.10","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Reports 2023 enforcement activity, with different measures covering the first three quarters or January–October.","ruler_attribution":"Institutional enforcement by national discipline and supervision authorities; no personal Xi action is specified in the source.","limitations":["The figures demonstrate extensive enforcement and continuing misconduct but do not establish impartiality, personal involvement, or overall reduction in corruption."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cf37c096c9894770","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"A 2023 audit report covering 18 provincial-level organs and 36 cities and counties identified overstated fiscal revenues, disorderly fines and taxes, illegal growth of hidden debt, false reporting of special-debt project revenues, and weaknesses in local financial management; it stated that central-department budget implementation was generally lawful while warning that local hidden-debt risks remained significant.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","5B.7","5B.9","8B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The report was delivered in 2023 and audited 2022 financial management, providing contemporaneous institutional findings relevant to 2023 governance.","ruler_attribution":"The audit was conducted by the National Audit Office under State Council authority; no personal Xi action is specified.","limitations":["The audited entities and period are limited; the source does not document subsequent correction or Xi's personal response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2970ddb34c2fec50","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"A Ministry of Justice article reported that China's revised Administrative Reconsideration Law enacted in 2023 designated administrative reconsideration as the main channel for resolving administrative disputes; ministry statistics cited 385,000 new administrative-reconsideration cases nationwide in 2023, exceeding new first-instance administrative litigation cases.","question_ids":["3B.4","4B.4","6B.7","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The law and case statistics concern 2023, though the article was published in August 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the law to the Chinese legislative and administrative system, not personally to Xi Jinping.","limitations":["The article is an official ministry-linked commentary and does not provide reversal, remedy, independence, or rights-protection rates."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied corpus is predominantly official Chinese government or party material and contains limited independent verification.","Several sources describe directives, institutional activity, or reported outputs without establishing personal Xi decision-making, implementation quality, causal attribution, or final outcomes.","No supplied document provides material evidence about nuclear posture, international war or peace conduct, or specific 2023 foreign-policy decisions."]}
